name: androidx.tracing.perfetto.StartupTracingConfigStoreIsEnabledGate
description: AndroidX Tracing Perfetto keeps this receiver disabled by default and checks its enabled state when deciding whether to restore saved startup-tracing settings. Tracing tools enable it while startup tracing is configured.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents saved startup-tracing settings from being restored; normal app use is unaffected.
